scope_reviewed: Offers and discounts across restaurants, cafés, stays, experiences, activities, markets/services
Community recommendations, threads, contributions, memberships and linked activities
source_alignment.note: This bank is aligned to the EyeMakkah consumer-app product rules and assumes offer/discount objects are resolved from the current app state after the offer layer is implemented. It defines intents only and does not modify or integrate the app.

purpose: Bilingual consumer-agent intent bank for offers/discounts, transactional actions, My Plan continuity, and community participation. Dynamic answers/actions must use the same EyeMakkah object states and offer data shown in the UI.

integration_contract.offer_rule: Offers must resolve dynamically from active offer records linked to current EyeMakkah objects. Do not invent a percentage, package, exclusivity flag, eligibility, expiry, or redemption path that is not present in current offer data.
integration_contract.offer_visibility_rule: Offer intents are cross-category. The same offer layer may apply to restaurants, cafés, stays/hotels, experiences, activities, markets/retail and services when those objects have an active offer.
integration_contract.offer_lifecycle_rule: Active and ending-soon offers may be recommended. Expired offers must not be promoted as active; they may only appear in historical/detail context if the product supports that state.
integration_contract.transaction_state_rule: Save ≠ Add to Plan ≠ Join/Going ≠ Booking handoff ≠ Confirmed ≠ Attended/Completed. Every handler must preserve this separation.
integration_contract.booking_rule: External booking/registration opens an outbound handoff and records only 'left to complete booking'. Move to Confirmed only after a real callback or explicit user confirmation.
integration_contract.plan_rule: My Plan is a continuity/timeline surface, not a synonym for saved items.
integration_contract.community_rule: Community knowledge may inform decisions but must not be rewritten as official fact. Preserve original human voice and source context.
integration_contract.privacy_rule: Do not expose attendee identities, exact user locations, nearby-user lists, or other private user data.
integration_contract.action_confirmation_rule: Action handlers must return a concise confirmation that names exactly which state changed and which states did not.
truthfulness: Do not fabricate active discounts or offers.
Do not claim a discount is EyeMakkah-exclusive unless the offer data explicitly marks it so.
Do not claim booking confirmation after an outbound click.
Do not infer attendance from booking or Plan state.
Do not infer booking from Save, Join, or Add to Plan.
Do not recommend expired offers or dormant/paused community activities as active.
Do not present community comments as verified operational facts.
Do not expose identities or precise locations of other users.
